title: AltarLegendaryWH
description: This plugin adds unique items and weapons directly from the AltarSMP server
body:
_The plugin is still in development, so there may be many bugs. We plan to add even more items and legendary weapons in the future. To follow the development or report bugs and download Resource Pack for plugin, visit_ [MyDiscordChannel](https://dsc.gg/whersssdevnotes)


**AltarLegendaryWH this is a custom plugin created by the author WHersss that adds Legendary Weapons, copper items and common items for crafting from the AltarSMP itself.**

# Download Resource Pack
- Download Resource Pack for plugin, visit [MyDiscordChannel](https://dsc.gg/whersssdevnotes)

# Language
  _in config.yml_
- select en_US for English
- select ru_RU for Russian

# LegendaryWeapons
- Bone Blade
- Vulcan's Crossbow
- BloodLust
- Frost Scythe
- Pure Blade
- Nightpiercer
- Shadow Blade
- Cutlass
- Knightfall
- Earth Gauntlet
- Withered Bone Blade
- Pale Gun

# Copper Armor
- Copper Helmet
- Copper Chestplate
- Copper Leggings
- Copper Boots

# Items
- Warden Heart
- Vulcan's Skull
- Illusion Core
- Weapon's Handle

# Commands
## AltarLegendary Commands
- the main command for this plugin **/altarlegendary, /al**
- reset all cooldowns for a player **/altarlegendary cooldownreset _nickname_**
- get custom items **/altarlegendary give item_name _nickname_**
- show legendary weapons menu **/altarlegendary show**
- reload config **/altarlegendary reload**
## Friendlist Commands
- add your friend to your friends list so that legendary weapons don't work on them **/friendlist add _nickname_**
- remove a player from your friends list **/friendlist remove _nickname_**
- see friends list **/friendlist list**
